title: More resilient Bedrock connections
summary: Bedrock players now benefit from an additional connection fallback when the primary route is temporarily unavailable.
body:
- Bedrock connection setup can now use an alternative route if the primary route is temporarily unavailable.
- This reduces avoidable connection failures without changing inventories, progression, statistics, or game rules.
- Java players and the server address remain unchanged.

Java: play.cookie-build.com
Bedrock: play.cookie-build.com, port 19132
